start: Active workout, Bench Press card with a 1:30 rest, 3 working sets, last time 3x8 at 60 kg

must_not: A rest measured for the first set of the card

steps.action: Wait about 4 minutes, then tick set 2
user_sees: While over, a red '+x:xx over' line under the timer (hidden after 10 minutes)
must_not: The timer stopping by itself without a word

steps.action: Tick set 3 after a normal rest, finish and save the workout
must_not: The long rest shown as an error or a warning on the workout

steps.action: Next workout, open the Bench Press card
user_sees: The Target note ends with 'Set 2 came after a long rest, so its goal is not raised.'
must_not: Set 2's extra reps raising its goal
The weight moved up because of set 2

start: Rest timer set to off (no planned rest), or Bench Press in a superset

steps.action: Tick three sets with a 5-minute gap each and save
must_not: A long-rest mark when there was no planned rest
A rest measured across a superset partner

user_sees: A normal Target note with no long-rest sentence
must_not: 'came after a long rest' in the note

start: Active workout; set 2 ticked, then unticked

steps.action: Untick set 2, wait, tick it again
must_not: The rest measured from the first, undone tick

steps.action: Tick set 3 before set 2 (out of order) and save
must_not: A rest measured from a later row instead of the tick just before it

start: Active workout; a timed exercise (Plank 60 s) and a set ticked 20 minutes late

steps.action: Tick Plank sets 60 s apart from their own length
user_sees: Rest measured after taking the set's own seconds off
must_not: A long-rest mark caused by the hold time itself

steps.action: Tick a set 20 minutes after the one before
must_not: That gap saved as a rest (over 15 minutes is not a rest)

start: Old phone with workouts where set 2 came after a long rest; new phone signed in to the same account, workouts brought back from the cloud copy

steps.action: On the new phone, open the Bench Press card
user_sees: The same Target note as on the old phone, with 'Set 2 came after a long rest, so its goal is not raised.'
must_not: The long-rest mark gone, so set 2's extra reps now raise the goal
A different Target on the two phones
